statement: A retired board keeps 7 days of dispute evidence, clamped one way only: what the retired side would pay from reserves is removed, what it is owed is paid as signed. The Arrival cell holds the one-way clamp only (spec/dispute/dispute.scm, bugs h3-no-clamp and h3-symmetric); the 7-day evidence window is on no spec page.
